items.label: Dimmable and Timer
items.value: The candle warmer lamp control the brightness and heat release to match different scent concentrations and candle lifetimes. The timer function allows you to sleep with peace of mind.

items.label: Pure and Rich Fragrance
items.value: The candle's scent is produced by the top-down candle warmer, without any burning smell or ash, making it safe for humans. This candle warmer utilizes the candle to its fullest, doubling the scent's duration compared to burning candles.

items.label: Safety and Aesthetics
items.value: No flames or smoke. Featuring a wooden base, a metal lamp body, and a flower-shaped lampshade design, this wax melts warmer serves as a delicate and functional decorative light for bedroom decor, living room decor aesthetic, studies, offices, yoga rooms, and more. It is also an excellent choice for Easter decorations.

items.label: Height Adjustable
items.value: With its stability and adjustable height, this candle warmer is suitable for all candle sizes.

items.label: Gift Idea
items.value: This wax melter makes a thoughtful gift for anyone special in your life. Whether for Mothers Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year, a housewarming, or other special occasions, it's a wonderful way to show your love. Ideal as a birthday gift for women or men, it's also a perfect choice for bridal shower gifts, bridesmaid proposal gifts, wedding gifts, mothers Day gifts, graduation gifts and teacher appreciation gifts.
